title: Zero Forcing in Generalized Petersen Graphs
headline: The computational baseline for the conjecture $Z(P(n,3))=8$ for all $n\ge 13$ has been reproduced, while the mathematical proof remains under independent audit.
description: Research on the zero-forcing number of the generalized Petersen graphs $P(n,3)$, focused on the conjecture that $Z(P(n,3))=8$ for every integer $n\ge 13$. The imported computational pilot is positive and its certificate and finite-search baseline have been reproduced in this repository, but the mathematical proof is still undergoing an independent hostile audit; no Lean formalisation, Palomar verification, or research paper has begun.
verification: Computational baseline reproduced; mathematical proof not yet independently accepted.
attribution: The target is Conjecture 5 in Arnav Krishnan's July 2026 preprint A correction to the Zero Forcing Number of the Generalized Petersen Graphs P(n,3) (arXiv:2607.19412v1). John Fairfax-Ball's repository has reproduced the imported computational baseline and is conducting an independent audit of the candidate proof; it does not claim authorship of the underlying conjecture.
